json_schema.description: Opaque per-call idempotency identity; use 8-128 characters and do not reuse it for different arguments.

r9_probe_guided_arm_collapsed.meaning: that arm no longer differs from an unmodified server, so any future guided-vs-baseline reading is really default-vs-baseline

boundaries_named: The ported C block indexes result['proposals'] without a guard. Measured on the candidate tree: a request_replan response carrying only the singular proposal, or none at all, raises KeyError('proposals') instead of returning the server decision. The same shape is already guarded on the line at backend/app/agent/gateway.py:116. No mainline test covers it (backend gate 72 of 72 green). This is verbatim from the Hermes source and was left as-is because the order scoped this lane to porting; a guard needs its own witness.

agent-mcp/tests/test_replan_proposal_view.py witnesses schemas, which landed with ORD-0328, so it passes on the tip too. It is carried as regression net for the contract, not as a witness for this port; the witnesses that can redden this port are the forms inside test_mcp_boundary.py, which is where the three arm cuts aim.
